global_rules: All expected outputs are candidate data.
Fixtures do not call Ollama and do not run the model.
Product Selector must not approve catalog_item_id, calculate prices, create documents, send email, or invent missing critical fields.

Thread notation in normalized output must use Latin M and x, for example M20x1,5.
